title: B. ezraft and Array
statement:
You are given a single integer $$n.$$ Construct an array of $$n$$ distinct positive integers $$a_1, \ldots, a_n$$ such that for all $$i \, (1 $\leq i \leq n)$$$, $$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + \ldots + a_n$$ is divisible by $$a_i,$$ or determine that no such array exists.

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$t$$ ($$1 $\leq t \leq 50$$$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first and only line of each test case contains a single integer $$n \, (1 $\leq n \leq 50).$$$

For each test case, if there is no solution, output a single integer $$-1$$.

Otherwise, output $$n$$ integers $$a_1, \ldots, a_n \, (1 $\leq a_i \leq 10^{17})$$$ — an array satisfying the conditions.

If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

In the first test case, the condition is clearly satisfied, since $$1$$ is divisible by itself.

In the second test case, the output is $$a = [1,9,2,6].$$ We have $$a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18,$$ which is divisible by all $$a_i.$$
